summary: Learn commercial strategy and revenue growth with pricing, channel, and forecasting tools. Build practical plans, dashboards, and revenue actions.
lede: Commercial strategy links customer, pricing, and channel choices to measurable revenue plans. For professionals in sales, marketing, pricing, business development, channel management, revenue operations, or finance, the subject covers customer segmentation, revenue analysis, pricing decisions, pipeline forecasting, and channel economics, with practical work on growth plans and revenue scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already influence revenue decisions and now need a more structured commercial strategy approach. It is especially relevant if you work across pricing, sales, marketing, business development, channel management, revenue operations, or finance and need to turn commercial insight into measurable growth plans.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to the course templates provided during training. A basic understanding of sales, pricing, or revenue reporting is expected, and familiarity with CRM reports or dashboard outputs will help you complete the exercises more effectively. No programming background is needed.
